question: What arithmetic object governs the global lift from the successful genus-one pair carrier to the genus-five three-cover carrier, and can ordinary rank-less-than-genus Chabauty apply to it?
selection: Only the fixed 01333,0b2d0,19e45 triple and its already retained rational lift. No new cover labels, original rational parameters, or original-curve point searches.
method: Verify the ramified double-cover geometry and character decomposition of the genus-five Jacobian into three elliptic product-character quotients and the genus-two triple-product quotient. Compute the three auxiliary elliptic Jacobians and bounded PARI effort-zero 2-descents. Form the eight-point ramification algebra over the two roots of 01333 and its exact primitive-element characteristic polynomial. Retain explicit equations and proof boundaries; do not treat rational points on the Jacobian factors as rational lifts on the original carrier.
failure_semantics: Timeout leaves the corresponding auxiliary rank UNKNOWN. Auxiliary ranks are not original-fibre ranks. Isogeny decomposition does not identify rational points on the carrier with arbitrary tuples of factor points. A ramified genus-five cover is not an elliptic isogeny or a torsor under its base elliptic curve.
boundary: Characterize the full native lifting obstruction and the viability of global rational-point methods, separately from incidence and point visibility.
